turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer's only matching metric is the signup-to-first-order rate, defined as the share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up (the signup day and the 29 after it); it has no "by 10 October" cut-off, so I could not compute that exact window. For the 11 customers who signed up on 1-31 August 2026 it returned no value (no August signup shows a first order within 30 days), so I cannot give a share. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
